VI.description: Fixture subject for the typedef-disconnect measurement. Its Config terminal is bound to Outer Config.ctl afterwards\2C which is itself a strict typedef whose Mode element is bound to Inner Mode.ctl - so the pane carries a typedef with a typedef inside it. The question this VI exists to answer is what lvai_placeholder_subvi's stub carries after cloning that pane.

FreeLabel.comment: Fixture pane for the typedef probe
